identity.description: Brex is a fully unified spend platform for finance teams (corporate cards, expenses, bill pay/payments, banking). developer.brex.com is its official developer portal for the Brex REST API.
identity.identity_notes: Developer portal and API docs are on Brex's own domains. The product is the Brex business spend/card platform, not an unrelated company named Brex. Quotes below came from summarizing fetches; verify verbatim before publication.

auth.oauth_flows: Partner OAuth 2.0: Authorization Code Grant for most APIs; Client Credentials Grant for the Onboarding API. Partners must get a client ID/secret from developer support.
auth.token_refresh: No refresh mechanism described. User tokens expire after 90 days of non-use and stop working when the associated user is non-active.
auth.scopes_notes: User tokens carry scopes chosen at creation, which set the data access level.

access.production_restrictions: Developer API agreement must be accepted by an account or card admin before use. Sending more than 1,000 payments per day requires contacting developer-support@brex.com. OAuth partner access requires developer support to issue client credentials. No sandbox was found in the sources reviewed; the sandbox_available value is 'no' only because no sandbox was mentioned, not because one was ruled out.

read_ops: list expenses, cards, users (per MCP tool list)
write_ops: manage card expenses, receipt matching, and receipt uploads
manage vendors and send ACH, domestic wires, and checks
manage users, locations, departments, and cards
refer customers and prefill signup information (Onboarding)
api.limitations: Payments volume above 1,000/day needs developer support. Brex MCP is in beta and its tools may change. No sandbox was found in the sources. Rate limits not established.
